source.title: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines, 23rd list (2023)
source.parent_document: The Selection and Use of Essential Medicines: Report of the WHO Expert Committee on Selection and Use of Essential Medicines, 2023 (WHO Technical Report Series, No. 1049, 2024) -- Annex 1, document pages 719-802
source.note: This is a structured transcription of Annex 1 (the 23rd Model List itself) prepared for reference/research use. It is not the authoritative WHO document and should not be used for clinical, regulatory, or procurement decisions -- consult the original PDF/IRIS record for that. Annex 2 (9th Model List of Essential Medicines for Children / EMLc, document pages 803+) is a related but separate list and is out of scope for this transcription. WHO's own executive summary states the 23rd EML totals 502 medicines (including fixed-dose combinations), up from 479 in 2021.
